titleEs: Maxroll Last Epoch vs ArreatSummit.gg — hub editorial vs EHG-endorsed
titleEn: Maxroll Last Epoch vs ArreatSummit.gg — editorial hub vs EHG-endorsed
descriptionEs: Maxroll es el editorial flagship con team profesional cross-ARPG; ArreatSummit es el único hub con endorsement explícito de Eleventh Hour Games. La elección depende de qué priorizas: depth editorial o pricing/trading integration.
descriptionEn: Maxroll is the editorial flagship with a cross-ARPG professional team; ArreatSummit is the only hub with Eleventh Hour Games' explicit endorsement. The choice depends on what you prioritize: editorial depth or pricing/trading integration.
verdictEs: Maxroll gana en pura amplitud y depth de builds editoriales. ArreatSummit gana en pricing guide (único feature que Maxroll no tiene) y endorsement EHG. Players de Merchant's Guild trading deberían usar los dos: Maxroll para builds, ArreatSummit para pricing.
verdictEn: Maxroll wins on pure editorial-build breadth and depth. ArreatSummit wins on the price guide (a feature Maxroll lacks) and EHG endorsement. Merchant's Guild traders should use both: Maxroll for builds, ArreatSummit for pricing.

useCases.reasonEs: Maxroll publica ~50+ builds per cycle con leveling+endgame variants extensos. ArreatSummit library más chica con menos variants.
useCases.reasonEn: Maxroll publishes ~50+ builds per cycle with extensive leveling+endgame variants. ArreatSummit has a smaller library with fewer variants.

useCases.labelEs: Price guide para Merchant's Guild trading
useCases.labelEn: Price guide for Merchant's Guild trading
useCases.reasonEs: ArreatSummit tiene price guide actualizado en collaboration con The Sanctum Market Discord. Maxroll no tiene equivalent.
useCases.reasonEn: ArreatSummit has an updated price guide in collaboration with The Sanctum Market Discord. Maxroll has no equivalent.

useCases.reasonEs: Tier lists de Maxroll vienen de team ladder-validated (Lizard IRL, etc.). ArreatSummit tier lists son OK pero menos autoritativas.
useCases.reasonEn: Maxroll tier lists come from a ladder-validated team (Lizard IRL, etc.). ArreatSummit tier lists are OK but less authoritative.

useCases.reasonEs: ArreatSummit es el único hub con endorsement explícito de Eleventh Hour Games. Maxroll opera independent sin backing oficial.
useCases.reasonEn: ArreatSummit is the only hub with explicit Eleventh Hour Games endorsement. Maxroll operates independently without official backing.

useCases.reasonEs: ArreatSummit invierte editorial bandwidth en dungeon guides per-boss. Maxroll tiene dungeon coverage pero menos granular.
useCases.reasonEn: ArreatSummit invests editorial bandwidth in per-boss dungeon guides. Maxroll has dungeon coverage but less granular.
